_: The sentences that make claude claude, and the one place they are written.
Excising these is what makes room for a different identity instead of a
second one arguing with the first. Both backends read this file - the
built-in wrapper at import, and the external cc-kernel-proxy by way of the
config check in proxy.py - so a reword is edited here once.
They are pinned to exact sentences of a particular Claude Code release, and
a future one that rewords its opening line will match none of them. That is
the failure this file exists to make loud: a miss on a real system prompt is
recorded in the usage log, marked on the status line, and reported by
`bottleneck kernel`, because the alternative is a session that looks fine
pattern  the regex excised from every system text block
witness  a plain substring of what it removes, used to check a rewrite from
the outside - if this survives a rewrite, the excision failed
matched  the Claude Code version the pattern was last confirmed against

excise.name: cli-sentence
excise.pattern: You are Claude Code, Anthropic's official CLI for Claude\.\s*

excise.name: interactive-agent
excise.pattern: You are an interactive agent that helps users with software engineering tasks\.\s*
excise.witness: interactive agent that helps users with software engineering
